offer.speaker: iruka
offer.text: Good morning, genin! Today you'll be split into three-person squads, each led by a jonin.

offer.speaker: iruka
offer.text: Your squad and your sensei will meet you here soon. I'm proud of every one of you.

offer.speaker: naruto
offer.text: Team Seven! With Sakura-chan! ...And Sasuke. Ugh.
